description: A clear plastic tube with a red lid sits on the bed in front of the hands, with a light-colored shirt nearby. The left hand holds the tube steady as a left-hand object while the right hand lifts off the red lid as a right-hand object, reaches into the open tube, and pulls the bundled shirt up and out; the shirt becomes a right-hand object as it is drawn free and dropped onto the bed, then the right hand picks up the red lid and presses it back onto the tube while the left hand continues stabilizing it as a left-hand object.
